cover.coreProposition: Multi-agent safety is an end-to-end execution property rather than the sum of local worker checks: a credible safety claim needs provenance across the authority-to-effect route, observable intervention, explicit trust assumptions, alternate-path assessment, and recovery evidence after propagation.
cover.visualMetaphor: A thin luminous signal enters a layered field, bends through several translucent gates, and still reaches a protected core through an unexpected side route.
cover.semanticObject: One origin signal, multiple layered gates, a protected core, and one surviving alternate path
cover.compositionIntent: Premium 16:9 editorial cover with deep navy depth, restrained cyan route lines, translucent security planes, one amber residual path, no text, and strong negative space
